versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the schedule-posts skill, enabling users to schedule and manage social media posts via PostWire.
- Supports single posts, bulk scheduling from lists/CSVs, queueing in the next available slot, and setting up recurring posts (paid plans).
- Integrates with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook Pages, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord, and X (with plan restrictions).
- Each post is checked for compliance with the rules of each selected social network before being queued.
- Allows users to view, move, or cancel scheduled posts, with plan limits and error feedback clearly communicated.
